name: TICKR Verified
description: TICKR is a transparent rule-based agent that paper-trades Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base Sepolia. Every decision carries its reasons and a keccak256 hash of the reasoning text. This Concordium layer adds what the public Base journal cannot: a verified identity. TICKR registers in the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004) for a Verified by Concordium badge, binds its Base agent key via CIS-8, and anchors every decision in an on-chain accountability log on Concordium testnet — so anyone can verify WHICH agent made a decision and that a verified human stands behind it. Testnet only; paper trading; not investment advice.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

skills.name: Analyze tokenized stocks
skills.description: Scores Coinbase tokenized stocks by published transparent rules (NAV freshness, supply depth, drift vs last snapshot) and emits BUY/HOLD/AVOID signals with reasons.

skills.name: Paper-trade with reason hash
skills.description: Paper-trades at NAV reference prices and logs each decision plus a keccak256 hash of its reasoning text, first to the Base Sepolia TradeJournal and then to the Concordium accountability log.

skills.name: Verify a Concordium badge
skills.description: Resolves a Verified by Concordium badge on-chain (owner, Active status) and checks the Agent Card SHA-256 against the on-chain metadata_hash.
